BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s';
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'application_round_cross_club',(SELECT count(*) FROM "Application" a JOIN "PipelineRound" r ON r.id=a."roundId" WHERE a."clubId"<>r."clubId"),
 'answer_question_cross_club',(SELECT count(*) FROM "ApplicationAnswer" x JOIN "Application" a ON a.id=x."applicationId" JOIN "ApplicationQuestion" q ON q.id=x."questionId" WHERE a."clubId"<>q."clubId"),
 'booking_slot_cross_club',(SELECT count(*) FROM "InterviewBooking" b JOIN "Application" a ON a.id=b."applicationId" JOIN "InterviewSlot" s ON s.id=b."slotId" WHERE a."clubId"<>s."clubId"),
 'booking_round_cross_club',(SELECT count(*) FROM "InterviewBooking" b JOIN "Application" a ON a.id=b."applicationId" JOIN "PipelineRound" r ON r.id=b."roundId" WHERE a."clubId"<>r."clubId"),
 'slot_over_capacity',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT s.id FROM "InterviewSlot" s JOIN "InterviewBooking" b ON b."slotId"=s.id GROUP BY s.id HAVING count(*)>s.capacity) x),
 'duplicate_application_round_booking',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT "applicationId","roundId" FROM "InterviewBooking" GROUP BY "applicationId","roundId" HAVING count(*)>1) x),
 'active_panel_cross_club',(SELECT count(*) FROM "InterviewPanelAssignment" p JOIN "Application" a ON a.id=p."applicationId" JOIN "ClubMember" m ON m.id=p."memberId" JOIN "PipelineRound" r ON r.id=p."roundId" WHERE p."revokedAt" IS NULL AND (m."clubId"<>a."clubId" OR r."clubId"<>a."clubId")),
 'task_assignment_scope_mismatch',(SELECT count(*) FROM "TaskAssignment" x JOIN "ClubTask" t ON t.id=x."taskId" JOIN "ClubMember" m ON m.id=x."memberId" WHERE m."clubId"<>t."clubId" OR m."userId"<>x."userId"),
 'invitation_school_mismatch',(SELECT count(*) FROM "ClubInvitation" i JOIN "Club" c ON c.id=i."clubId" WHERE i."schoolId"<>c."schoolId"),
 'pending_duplicate_email_invites',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT "clubId",lower(email) FROM "ClubInvitation" WHERE status='PENDING' AND "revokedAt" IS NULL AND "expiresAt">now() GROUP BY "clubId",lower(email) HAVING count(*)>1) x),
 'claimed_operational_clubs_without_active_owner',(SELECT count(*) FROM "Club" c WHERE c."claimedAt" IS NOT NULL AND c."suspendedAt" IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "ClubMember" m JOIN "User" u ON u.id=m."userId" WHERE m."clubId"=c.id AND m."isOwner" AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u."disabledAt" IS NULL)),
 'notifications_without_outbox',(SELECT count(*) FROM "UserNotification" n LEFT JOIN "NotificationEmailOutbox" o ON o."notificationId"=n.id WHERE o."notificationId" IS NULL),
 'decision_letter_club_mismatch',(SELECT count(*) FROM "DecisionLetter" d JOIN "Application" a ON a.id=d."applicationId" WHERE d."clubId"<>a."clubId"),
 'schools',(SELECT count(*) FROM "School"),
 'club_university_count',(SELECT count(DISTINCT "schoolId") FROM "Club"),
 'not_valid_constraints',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.connamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT c.convalidated)
 ) AS checks; COMMIT;
